verdict.rationale: Founder Law is a legal-services firm, and taking your case file with you when you switch counsel is a fair question for this kind of provider, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any data export, open-format download, or client-file portability. The probes show only an llms.txt and no API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
